summary: Re-tested fix from iteration_160: conditional guard `{(modal === 'email' || modal === 'push') && (...)}` restored around Email/Push Modal in Person360.jsx PersonActions. Verified via UI that opening a Partner profile no longer triggers the app-level ErrorBoundary ('Something went wrong'). Email, Push, and Reset Device modals all open cleanly and close without crash. Merchant profile also renders normally (same shared PersonActions). Device-history area renders with 'No device registered yet — the partner will lock to their next login device.' Zero pageerror events captured across the entire flow.
critical_code_review_comments: Person360.jsx is ~1143 lines — consider splitting PersonActions and each Modal branch into separate components to prevent regressions like the one fixed here (an accidental deletion of the outer guard broke the entire Admin partner profile).
Consider adding a defensive early-return inside the modal body (`if (!modal) return null;`) so a future missing-guard mistake degrades gracefully instead of throwing at `modal.toUpperCase()`.
test_credentials: One-click 'Login as Admin' demo button on /login (data-testid=demo-admin). Backup: phone +919000000000, OTP 123456.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Fix from iteration_160 verified. Steps: goto /login -> click [data-testid=demo-admin] -> click [data-testid=nav-partners] -> click first table row. Confirms Person360 Overview + PersonActions render, and Email/Push/Reset-Device modals open. Partner tested: Pankaj Sinha (AZP1961927). Merchant profile also verified.
rca of the issue: Fixed in iteration_160. RCA: PersonActions rendered a <Modal> for Email/Push whose header calls `modal.toUpperCase()`; when the outer conditional `(modal === 'email' || modal === 'push') && (...)` was removed, the modal mounted with modal=null causing a TypeError caught by the app-level ErrorBoundary. The guard has been restored at Person360.jsx line 898 and verified visually + programmatically.
